digest.component_or_area: code-review runtime and project criteria system
propositions: Configured project-specific code-review criteria merge successfully but never execute, creating a silent failure indistinguishable from a rubric finding no issues.
The code-review runtime executes only static workflow lists and packaged decision/eval lookups, missing the project-criteria extension surface advertised in ADR 0017 and criteria_routing.json.
Activated project criteria must run exactly once per review through a runner-side dynamic fan-in pattern reusing the plan-review seam without introducing new workflow DSL fields.
Project prompt and eval assets must resolve from the reviewed repository snapshot, raising a fatal LLMError before model execution if missing or malformed.
Pass 3 must apply repository-effective routing (threshold, blocking posture, nit-suppression) using logical criterion ids mapped from physical prompt ids without invoking an LLM.
